title: FitSquad Phase 1 product blueprint
description: Define the smallest implementation-ready blueprint for FitSquad Tourism Platform Phase 1 only. Respect the explicit scope limits: public package pages, reservation submission, deposit-or-full payment choice, basic availability, confirmation emails, and minimal admin reservation management. Exclude contracts, invoicing, advanced finance, CRM, dashboards, promo logic, and user accounts.
acceptance_criteria: state the exact Phase 1 feature set
identify the minimum user flow from package discovery to reservation confirmation
identify the minimum internal admin flow for reservation management
explicitly list out-of-scope items that must stay excluded
